BL-966 — effective_backlog_depth_cli silently returns a different cap per checkout - worktrees lack .swarmforge/ so the identity fallback yields 3 while master resolves 7, with no warning (fail-open on a governance constant)
What it solves: 1:1 - the coordinator's mint request (note 20260820T000030Z_000635, evidence d0c649827, itself adjudicating the architect's challenge note 000270) produced this ticket and no other. The coordinator's operational ruling stands and is not re-litigated here: 7 is operative for the live swarm; this tic…
Approval context: One design ruling to confirm: resolve-then-answer rather than fail-closed. From a worktree the CLI RESOLVES the master identity and answers correctly (rather than erroring, since a role's legitimate question is "what is the cap"); only a repository with no identity at all falls back to the default …
BL-966 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-966" (or "reject BL-966 <reason>") to act.
